Accent/data colours excluded via an explicit allow-list.

knownRemainingLimitations: The static-analysis sweep in app.js flagged ~60 candidate undeclared identifiers in template literals; most are callback parameters or hoisted functions, but they were NOT individually eliminated. The one confirmed runtime crash (auto in showFinanceModal) was found by playing, not by static analysis, so absence of further crashes is based on runtime observation of the paths exercised, not exhaustive proof.
softBtn in the original lives on the intro page (#softBtn2); born-somewhere's toggle is only in the life-view topbar.
Original's family panel lives in column C; this was corrected in v5.47 to match.

staticAnalysisFollowUp.concern: Earlier per-function heuristic flagged ~60 candidate undeclared identifiers in template literals; left unresolved.
staticAnalysisFollowUp.resolutionMethod: File-wide declaration audit: collected every name bound by const/let/var/function/class, all destructuring bindings, all function parameters (named and arrow, including single-param arrow without parens), loop/callback variables — then subtracted a browser-global allow-list (Math, JSON, document, window, location, fetch, setTimeout, etc.) and app-level globals (STATE, COUNTRIES, I18N, LANG, STORAGE_KEY, ...).
staticAnalysisFollowUp.conclusion: All 193 identifiers used inside ${...} are either declared somewhere in app.js or are legitimate browser/app globals. No remaining undeclared-variable crash risk of this shape.
staticAnalysisFollowUp.caveat: A file-wide audit cannot prove scope-correctness (a name declared in one function and used in another would pass). Dynamic coverage remains the stronger check: the one real crash of this class (auto in showFinanceModal) was found by playing, not by static analysis.
